blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) programming ka aisa tareeqa hai jis mein program objects se design hota hai, aur yeh objects asal duniya ki cheezon ko dikhate hain.
Class aik blueprint ya template (saancha) hai jis se objects banaye jate hain. Yeh object ki properties aur behaviours (kaam) tay karti hai.
Object class ka instance (namoona) hai. Yeh asal duniya ki kisi cheez ko apne data aur functions ke saath dikhata hai.
Modularity ka matlab hai program ko chhote, sambhalne ke qabil hisson mein baantna taake har hissa alag se banaya aur sambhala ja sake.
Reusability ka matlab hai pehle se likha hua code program ke doosre hisson ya doosre programs mein dobara istemal karna.
Encapsulation data aur us se jure methods ko class ke andar ikattha rakhne ka amal hai. Yeh data ko be-ijazat pohanch (unauthorized access) se bachati hai.
Inheritance OOP ka concept hai jis mein aik class doosri class ki properties aur methods istemal kar sakti hai.
Polymorphism ka matlab hai aik hi method ya operation ko object ke mutabiq mukhtalif tareeqon se istemal karna. Is se code lachakdar (flexible) aur halaat ke mutabiq dhalne wala banta hai.

items: Class naqsha hai, object us se bani asal cheez.
Encapsulation data bachati; inheritance code dobara use aur barhati; polymorphism aik method ko kai shaklein deti.
